DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: キャッシュカードのご相談ですね。お手元のカードについて何がありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking about your cash card. What happened to the card you have?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日なくしたと思って電話で止めてもらいました。今朝、洗濯前の上着から見つかったので、また使っていいか聞きに来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日電話で停止依頼したカードが上着から見つかり再使用してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought I'd lost it yesterday and had it blocked by phone. This morning I found it in my jacket before washing, so I came to ask whether I can use it again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may reuse a card found in your jacket after requesting a block by phone yesterday. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 停止の受付状況を確認します。昨日の電話で、再発行まで申し込まれましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll check the blocking request. During yesterday's call, did you also request a replacement?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 停止だけお願いしたつもりです。再発行という言葉も聞きましたが、そこはよく分かりませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 停止だけ依頼したつもりだが電話の再発行の説明を理解できなかったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I intended to request only a block. I heard the word replacement too, but didn't understand that part well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you intended only a block but did not understand the replacement explanation by phone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 本人確認の後で履歴を確認しましょう。こちらでは、現在停止されていて再発行の申し込みはないことが確認できました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the history after confirming your identity. We have confirmed that it is currently blocked and no replacement was requested.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 再発行はまだなのですね。暗証番号を入力できれば、停止されたままでも使えると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 再発行未申込と理解し暗証番号が分かれば停止中でも使えると思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: So replacement hasn't been requested. I thought knowing the PIN meant I could use it even while blocked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Acknowledge no replacement request, and explain you thought knowing the PIN allowed use while blocked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 暗証番号が分かっても、停止中のカードを使えるとは限りません。見つかったカードの取扱いは、担当の手続き確認が済むまでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Knowing the PIN doesn't necessarily make a blocked card usable. Please wait until the staff finish checking the procedure for the found card.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、試しに現金を引き出すのはやめます。このカードは自分で切って捨てた方がいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 試しの引出しをやめると伝えカードを切って捨てるべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I won't try withdrawing cash. Should I cut up and discard this card myself?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you won't try a withdrawal and ask whether to cut up and discard the card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今は切らずに保管してください。手続きを確認するため担当へおつなぎしますので、カードもそのままお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Keep it without cutting it for now. I'll connect you to the staff to check the procedure, so bring the card unchanged too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 切らずに持っておきます。停止の解除ができるかと、別のカードが必要かを担当者に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 切らず保管し停止解除の可否と別カードの必要性を担当に確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll keep it uncut. I want to ask the staff whether it can be unblocked and whether I need another card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will keep it uncut and ask staff about unblocking and the need for another card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その二点を担当へ伝えます。カードは人目につかないようしまって、こちらの席へどうぞ。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll tell the staff those two questions. Put the card away out of view and come to this seat. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの商品について、何かお気づきの点がありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Did you notice something about the product you brought?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日買ったこの缶の横がへこんでいました。袋から出したときに気づきましたが、買う前からかどうかは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 帰宅後に缶のへこみに気づき購入前からかは不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The side of this can I bought yesterday was dented. I noticed when taking it out of the bag, but don't know whether it was like that before purchase.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain noticing the dent after returning home, without knowing whether it predated purchase. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 経緯を教えていただきありがとうございます。購入時のレシートと、缶の状態を確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you for explaining. Let us check the receipt and the can's condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: レシートはこちらです。同じものを二個買っていて、もう一個はへこんでいません。こちらは開けずに持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: レシートを示し二個購入の一個だけへこみ未開封で持参したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here's the receipt. I bought two identical ones; the other isn't dented. I brought this one without opening it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the receipt and say only one of two purchased cans is dented, and you brought it unopened. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 未開封ですね。内容物を出さず、この状態で担当者に見てもらいます。袋の中で重い物と一緒になっていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: It's unopened. We'll have the staff see it in this condition without removing the contents. Was it in the bag with heavy things?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 米の袋と一緒でしたが、缶は上に置きました。運ぶ途中でぶつけた記憶もないので、原因は言い切れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 米と同じ袋で缶を上に置き衝突の記憶はないが原因は断定できないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: It was with a bag of rice, but I put the can on top. I don't remember hitting it on the way either, so I can't state the cause for certain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain it shared a bag with rice but was on top; you remember no impact but cannot determine the cause. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かりました。原因を決めつけず、商品の状態として確認します。交換をご希望ですか、それとも返金についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. We'll check its condition without assuming the cause. Would you like an exchange or to ask about a refund?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は同じ商品を使いたいので、交換できるか知りたいです。ただ、先に別の缶を取ってきていいのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今日使いたいので交換可否を知りたいと伝え先に別缶を取ってよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to use the same product today, so I'd like to know whether an exchange is possible. May I get another can first?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you need it today and want to know whether exchange is possible, then ask if you can fetch another can first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当者が可否を判断するまでは、この窓口でお待ちください。交換品を取る必要があれば、こちらから売場へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Wait at this counter until the staff decide. If a replacement needs fetching, we will guide you to the sales area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では勝手に取り替えず、ここで待ちます。元の缶とレシートをそのまま確認してもらってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 勝手に取り替えず窓口で待ち元の缶とレシートを確認してもらうと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I won't replace it myself; I'll wait here. Please have the original can and receipt checked as they are.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait without exchanging it yourself and have the original can and receipt checked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確かにお預かりしました。担当者へ事情を伝えますので、少々お待ちください。お持ちくださってありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've received them. Please wait a moment while I explain the circumstances to the staff. Thank you for bringing them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 園内の案内図をご覧になっていますね。歩くコースをお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're looking at the park map. Are you choosing a walking route?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 少し散歩したいのですが、一周すると疲れそうです。今日は十五分くらいで入口へ戻れる歩き方にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一周では疲れそうなので十五分程度で入口へ戻る散歩を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like a little walk, but a full circuit seems tiring. Today I want to return to the entrance in about fifteen minutes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request a walk returning to the entrance in about fifteen minutes because a full circuit seems tiring. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 入口から池の手前までが平らな道です。一周せず、同じ道を戻る歩き方にできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The path from the entrance to before the pond is flat. You can return along the same path rather than complete a circuit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 池に着くことより、疲れる前に戻る方を優先します。途中で折り返す目印はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 池到達より疲れる前の帰路を優先し途中の折返し目印を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll prioritize returning before I'm tired over reaching the pond. Is there a landmark for turning back along the way?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Prioritize returning before fatigue over reaching the pond, and ask for a turning landmark. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 入口から見える白い案内柱があります。そこを目安にしてもよいですが、歩く速さは人によるので時計も見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: There is a white information post visible from the entrance. You can use it as a guide, but walking speeds vary, so watch your clock too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では七分くらい歩いたら戻り始めます。白い柱より前でも、その時刻になったら引き返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 七分で戻り始め柱に到達しなくても時刻で引き返すと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll start back after about seven minutes. Even before the white post, I'll turn around at that time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to start back at seven minutes, using time even if you haven't reached the post. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それなら時間に余裕を持ちやすいですね。白い柱の手前には休憩できるベンチもあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: That should make it easier to allow enough time. There is also a resting bench before the white post.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 休める場所もあるのですね。帰りに別の道へ入らないよう、案内柱から入口が見えるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 休憩場所を理解し帰りに迷わないよう案内柱から入口が見えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: So there's somewhere to rest too. To avoid taking another path back, I'd like to know whether I can see the entrance from the post.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Acknowledge the resting place and ask whether the entrance is visible from the post so you won't lose your return route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 柱の位置から入口の門が見えます。戻るときは門を正面に見て、来た道を歩いてください。脇道には入らなくて大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can see the entrance gate from the post. Return along the path you came, facing the gate. There's no need to take a side path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 七分で折り返し、門の見える同じ道を戻ります。疲れたらベンチで休み、十五分に間に合わせようと急がないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 七分で同じ道を門へ戻り疲れればベンチで休んで時間に合わせて急がないとまとめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll turn at seven minutes and follow the same path back toward the visible gate. If tired, I'll rest on the bench rather than hurry to meet fifteen minutes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sum up: turn at seven minutes, return along the same path to the gate, rest if tired and don't rush to meet the time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、ご自分のペースを優先してください。無理なく散歩を楽しんで、気をつけていってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, prioritize your own pace. Enjoy your walk without overdoing it, and take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗車券のことでお困りですか。携帯の画面が消えてしまったようですが。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with your ticket? It looks as if your phone screen went off.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 充電がほとんど残っていません。今日は佐世保へ行くだけなので、携帯を使わない切符を買えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 携帯の充電が少なく佐世保へ行くだけなので携帯なしで使う切符を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: There's hardly any charge left. I'm only going to Sasebo today; can I buy a ticket I can use without my phone?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: With little phone charge and only a trip to Sasebo, request a ticket usable without a phone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この窓口で紙の片道切符をお買い求めいただけます。携帯で、すでに乗車券を購入されてはいませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can buy a paper one-way ticket at this counter. Have you already purchased a ticket on your phone?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 調べただけで、まだ購入していません。一日乗車券の案内も見ましたが、途中で降りないなら片道でよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 携帯ではまだ買っておらず途中下車しない場合の片道と一日券を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I only looked it up and haven't bought one. I saw a day-pass guide too; if I won't get off en route, is one-way suitable?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you haven't bought by phone and ask about one-way versus a day pass when not stopping en route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今回のように佐世保まで一度だけ乗るなら、まず片道の運賃を確認してお選びいただけます。一日乗車券は何度か乗る予定も含めて比較するものです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: For a single ride to Sasebo like this, you can first check the one-way fare. Compare a day pass when considering plans for several rides too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 片道の紙の切符にします。携帯で払えないので、現金でも買えるか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 片道の紙切符を選び現金で購入できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll choose a paper one-way ticket. I can't pay by phone, so please tell me whether cash is accepted.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose a paper one-way ticket and ask whether you can buy with cash. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、この窓口では現金で購入できます。乗車区間を確かめてから、お支払いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, cash is accepted at this counter. Please check the journey section before paying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 区間はたびら平戸口から佐世保で間違いありません。買った切符は、乗るときにも見せる必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: たびら平戸口から佐世保と確認して乗車時に現物を見せるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Tabira-Hiradoguchi to Sasebo is correct. Will I need to show the actual ticket when boarding too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm Tabira-Hiradoguchi to Sasebo and ask whether to show the physical ticket when boarding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 乗るときは係員の案内に従ってご提示ください。切符を携帯の写真にする必要はありません。到着するまで現物をなくさずにお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Show it following the staff's instructions when boarding. You don't need a phone photo of it. Keep the actual ticket safe until you arrive.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 紙の切符を出せるよう上着のポケットに入れます。たびら平戸口から佐世保までの片道を、現金でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 切符を取り出せるポケットで保管し希望区間の片道を現金購入すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll keep it in my jacket pocket so I can take it out. One-way from Tabira-Hiradoguchi to Sasebo, paying cash, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the ticket in an accessible pocket and state you will buy the requested one-way journey with cash. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 区間を確認してお渡しします。携帯とは別に切符をお持ちください。お気をつけて、いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll check the section and give it to you. Keep the ticket separately from your phone. Have a safe journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 住宅の設備確認についての通知ですね。こちらの担当窓口で伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: This notice concerns inspection of housing equipment. We can hear your query at this responsible counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 通知に来週の水曜に訪問すると書いてありますが、その日は出張です。留守でも部屋に入られるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 水曜は出張で不在なので留守の部屋に入るのか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says they'll visit next Wednesday, but I'll be away on business. Will they enter my room while I'm out?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check whether they will enter the empty room because you're away on business Wednesday. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この確認は入居者の方が立ち会う予定です。留守だからといって、連絡なしに入ることはありません。ご都合を担当へお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The tenant is expected to be present for this inspection. They won't enter without contacting you just because you're absent. Let the staff know your availability.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: それなら安心しました。鍵を近所の人に預けるのではなく、別の日にしてもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 近所へ鍵を預けるのではなく訪問日を変えてほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's reassuring. Rather than leave my key with a neighbor, I'd like another visit date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request a different visit date instead of leaving the key with a neighbor. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 別日をご希望と記録します。通知には今週の金曜までに連絡とありますが、来週の出張からはいつ戻られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll record that request. The notice says contact us by this Friday; when will you return from next week's business trip?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 来週の木曜の夜に戻ります。翌日の午後なら在宅できますが、その時間で確定したと考えていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 来週木曜夜に戻り翌日の金曜午後在宅可能だが確定か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Next Thursday night. I can be home the following afternoon, but should I consider that time confirmed?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you return Thursday night and can be home Friday afternoon, then ask whether it is confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まだ担当の予定確認が必要です。金曜午後をご希望として伝え、決まった日時を折り返しお知らせします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff still need to check their schedule. We'll pass on Friday afternoon as your preference and call back with the confirmed date and time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では金曜午後は希望だけですね。出張中も携帯で連絡を受けられます。番号をこの余白に書いて渡せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 金曜午後は希望のみと理解し出張中も連絡できる携帯番号を記入したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: So Friday afternoon is only a preference. I can take calls on my mobile during the trip too. Can I write the number in this margin and hand it in?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Acknowledge Friday afternoon is only a preference and request to write a mobile number reachable during the trip. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、お部屋の番号とあわせてご記入ください。つながらない場合に備えて、折り返し先の番号もこの案内でお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, write your room number too. Keep the callback number in this guide in case we cannot reach you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 部屋番号と携帯番号を書きました。折り返しの連絡で訪問日を確認するまで、鍵は自分で保管しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 部屋と携帯の番号を記入し訪問日確定まで鍵を自分で保管すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've written my room and mobile numbers. I'll keep the key myself until the callback confirms the visit date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you wrote the room and mobile numbers and will keep the key yourself until the visit is confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望を受け付けました。日時が決まり次第ご連絡します。出張の際もどうぞお気をつけて。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've received your request and will contact you once the date is set. Take care on your business trip too. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お声が聞き取りにくそうですね。こちらでお話を伺ってもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: It seems difficult for you to hear. May I speak with you here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今朝から右耳が聞こえにくいです。左側から話していただけると助かります。こちらで受診するのは初めてです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 今朝から右耳が聞こえにくく左側から話してほしいと頼み初診と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My right ear has been hard to hear with since this morning. It would help if you spoke from my left. This is my first visit here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your right hearing has been difficult since this morning, request speech from the left, and mention your first visit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 左側からお話ししますね。聞こえ方が変わったのは急でしたか。痛みやめまいはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll speak from your left. Did the hearing change suddenly? Do you have pain or dizziness?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 朝起きたときに急に気づきました。痛みもめまいもありませんが、右耳だけ詰まったように感じます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 朝起きて急に気づき痛みやめまいはなく右耳に詰まる感じがあると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I suddenly noticed on waking this morning. No pain or dizziness, but my right ear alone feels blocked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer that you noticed suddenly on waking, have no pain or dizziness, and the right ear feels blocked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その経過を診療担当へ伝えます。受付で確認する書類と、飲んでいるお薬がわかる物はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll tell the clinical staff that history. Do you have the documents for reception and something identifying medicines you take?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 資格確認書を持っています。毎日飲む薬はなく、お薬手帳も今は持っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 資格確認書があり毎日飲む薬はなくお薬手帳は持参していないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have my insurance eligibility confirmation certificate. I don't take daily medicine and don't have my medication notebook with me now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have the eligibility confirmation certificate, take no daily medicine, and haven't brought the medication notebook. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お持ちの書類を受付へお出しください。診察までに症状が変わったら、近くの職員に知らせてください。お名前でお呼びするとき、聞き取りづらいかもしれませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Give your documents to reception. If symptoms change before your examination, tell nearby staff. You may have trouble hearing your name called.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 呼ばれても気づかないかもしれません。受付に近い席で待ちたいので、顔を見て知らせてもらうことはできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 名前を呼ばれても気づけない可能性があり受付近くで待ち顔を見て知らせてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I might not notice the call. I'd like to wait near reception; could you look at my face to let me know?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain you may miss your name and request waiting near reception and being notified face-to-face. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受付の見える席をご案内します。呼び出しのときはお顔を見てお声がけするよう担当にも伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll show you a seat with reception in view. I'll also tell the staff to face you when calling.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。その席で待ちます。症状が変わったら黙って待たずに知らせますし、聞こえない説明は書いていただくようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内された席で待ち症状変化は伝え聞こえない説明は書いてもらうと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll wait there. If symptoms change, I won't silently keep waiting; I'll tell staff, and ask for explanations in writing if I can't hear them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you'll wait in the indicated seat, report changes, and request written explanations you cannot hear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まず受付へご案内します。失礼いたします。どうぞお大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. First I'll guide you to reception. Excuse me, and please take care of yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その袋には、届けていただく品物が入っていますか。中身を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Does that bag contain something you are handing in? Please tell me what is inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 海沿いのベンチの下で携帯電話を拾いました。ぬれていたので、持ってきた空の袋に入れてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 海沿いのベンチ下の携帯がぬれていたので空の袋で持参したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I found a mobile phone under a bench by the sea. It was wet, so I put it in an empty bag I had brought.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the phone under a seaside bench was wet, so you brought it in an empty bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お預かりします。拾った時刻と、どのベンチだったかを教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll take it. Could you tell me when you found it and which bench?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 午後四時ごろです。バス停から海のほうへ歩いて二つ目のベンチで、座面の下に落ちていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 十六時ごろバス停から海側の二つ目のベンチの下で拾ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Around four in the afternoon. It was under the second bench walking from the bus stop toward the sea.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you found it around 16:00 under the second bench toward the sea from the bus stop. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 位置も記録します。拾った後、持ち主を探している方などに会われましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll record the location too. After finding it, did you meet anyone looking for the owner or similar?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一人、自分の携帯だと言う人が来ました。でも、どんなケースか聞くと答えられなかったので、渡しませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の携帯と名乗る人がケースを答えられず渡さなかったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: One person came saying it was their phone. But they couldn't answer what the case looked like, so I didn't hand it over.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you did not give it to someone claiming ownership because they couldn't describe the case. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その方への返還はせず、ここへ届けに来られたのですね。端末を開いて、連絡先などを確認されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: So you brought it here without returning it to that person. Did you open the device to check contacts or similar information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いいえ、画面は消えていて、ぬれていたので電源も入れませんでした。その人には、警察へ届けるとだけ伝えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 画面が消えぬれていたため電源も入れず名乗る人には警察へ届けると伝えたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: No. The screen was off, and because it was wet I didn't switch it on either. I only told the person I'd take it to the police.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the screen was off, it was wet so you didn't turn it on, and you told the claimant you would hand it to police. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: わかりました。所有者の確認と返還はこちらで対応します。届け出のため、お名前と連絡先をご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We'll verify ownership and handle return here. Please write your name and contact details for the report.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 名前と連絡先を書きました。袋ごとお預けして、控えを受け取ります。またその人に会ったら、返還の相談はこちらへするよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 氏名連絡先を書き袋と控えを受け渡し名乗る人には警察への返還相談を案内すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've written them. I'll hand over the whole bag and receive the receipt. If I meet that person again, I'll tell them to consult here about return.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you wrote name and contacts, exchange the bag for a receipt, and direct the claimant to police for return inquiries. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 袋ごと確かにお預かりしました。控えはこちらです。持ち主の確認はこちらにお任せください。ご協力ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've received the bag. Here is your receipt. Leave the ownership checks to us. Thank you for cooperating. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 以前のお住まいに郵便が届いたというご相談ですね。お引っ越し後、こちらへの届け出はお済みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your query is about mail reaching your previous home. Have you filed a notice here since moving?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 役所で住所を変えたので、郵便も変わると思っていました。昨日、前の家に住む父から私宛ての封筒が届いたと言われました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 役所で住所を変えれば郵便も変わると思い旧居の父に自分宛て封筒が届いたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I changed my address at city hall and thought mail would change too. Yesterday my father, who lives at the old home, said an envelope for me arrived.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you thought city-hall address changes also redirected mail, but your father at the old home received your envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 市役所の住所変更とは別に、郵便の転居手続きがあります。こちらでの届け出は、まだということでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Postal moving procedures are separate from changing your address at city hall. So you haven't filed the postal notice yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、郵便の手続きはしていません。役所から自動で伝わるわけではないんですね。今からでも相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 郵便の届けはしておらず自動連携ではないと理解し今から相談できるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I haven't done the postal procedure. It isn't automatically passed on from city hall, then. Can I consult now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say no postal notice was filed, acknowledge no automatic link, and ask whether you can consult now. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今からお手続きの案内をします。旧住所と新住所をご用意ください。すでにお父様の所へ届いた封筒は、どちらにありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll explain the procedure now. Prepare the old and new addresses. Where is the envelope already delivered to your father?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 父が家で保管しています。封筒を勝手に捨てず、次に会うまで置いておいてもらうつもりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 父が旧居で保管し捨てず次に会うまで置いてもらう予定と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: He's keeping it at home. I'll ask him not to discard it and to keep it until we next meet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain your father is keeping it at the old home and will keep it undiscarded until you meet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それなら、その封筒の受け取りはお父様とご相談ください。転居手続きをした後も、差出人には新しい住所をお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then arrange receiving that envelope with your father. Even after postal procedures, tell the sender your new address too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 差出人は語学学校です。学校にも住所を伝えます。今日届けを出したら、明日から全部新居に届きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 差出人の語学学校にも新住所を知らせ今日手続きすれば明日開始か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: The sender is my language school. I'll tell the school too. If I submit today, will all mail reach my new home from tomorrow?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll notify the language school and ask whether filing today starts redirection tomorrow. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 開始までに時間がかかる場合があるため、明日からとはお約束できません。ご希望の日を含め、受付で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: It may take time to start, so we cannot promise tomorrow. We'll check at reception, including your desired start date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では転居手続きの案内をお願いします。学校に新住所を知らせ、父にも、しばらく私宛ての郵便が来たら連絡するよう頼みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 転居手続きの案内を求め学校へ住所変更を知らせ父に旧居郵便の連絡を頼むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then please explain the moving procedure. I'll notify the school and ask my father to contact me if mail for me arrives for a while.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request moving-procedure guidance, notify the school, and ask your father to report mail at the old address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 必要な記入事項をご案内します。届いた封筒の保管もご家族で確かめてください。本日はご相談ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll explain the required entries. Check with family about keeping the delivered envelope too. Thank you for consulting us today. Take care going home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご住所についてのご相談ですね。新しいお住まいは、もうお決まりでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking about your address. Is your new home already decided?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家を建て替える間、親戚の家に住みます。銀行の通知が取り壊した家に届かないよう、仮住まいへ変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 建て替え中は親戚宅に住み取り壊した旧宅に銀行通知が届かないよう変更希望と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'll live with relatives while my house is rebuilt. I want the bank's notices sent to that temporary home, not the demolished house.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you'll stay with relatives during rebuilding and want to prevent bank notices reaching the demolished old home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 現在住んでいる場所と、住所を確認できる書類を確認してから手続きをご案内します。仮住まいはいつからですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll check where you currently live and documents confirming the address before explaining procedures. When did the temporary stay begin?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日からです。ただ、本人確認書類の住所はまだ古いままです。親戚の家の住所を書いたメモだけで変更できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昨日から住むが本人確認書類は旧住所で住所メモだけで変更できるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yesterday. But my identification still has the old address. Can I change it with just a note of my relatives' address?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you've lived there since yesterday but ID still has the old address, and ask whether an address note alone permits change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: メモだけで変更できるとはご案内できません。この銀行で必要な書類を担当に確認します。今のご本人確認書類を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can't say a note alone is enough. I'll ask the staff which documents this bank requires. May I see your current ID?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらです。建て替えが終われば元の場所へ戻る予定ですが、一時的でも変更の相談は必要ですよね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 書類を見せ建て替え後戻る予定でも一時住所の変更相談が必要か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here. I plan to return to the original location after rebuilding, but even a temporary address needs consultation, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show your ID and check the need for temporary-address consultation despite planning to return after rebuilding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、通知を受け取れる登録にするため確認しましょう。戻られた際にも、登録住所を見直す必要があるかご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, let's check so your registration allows notices to reach you. When you return, ask whether the registered address needs reviewing again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 親戚の表札には私の名前がありません。送付先に『田中方』を入れたいのですが、その書き方も確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分の名前が表札にないので田中方を送付先に入れる書き方を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: My name isn't on my relatives' nameplate. I'd like care of Tanaka in the mailing address; can I check how to write that too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say your name isn't on the nameplate, and ask how to include care of Tanaka in the mailing address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 表札と宛名が違う点も担当へ伝えます。記載できる送付先と必要書類を確認した上でご案内しますので、今日は変更が完了したとは扱いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll tell the staff that the nameplate and addressee differ. We must check acceptable mailing details and documents first, so today's change isn't complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。仮住まいの住所と『田中方』の希望をメモに残します。必要な書類を確認してから、改めて手続きに来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 希望住所と田中方を記録し必要書類を確かめて改めて手続きすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll note the temporary address and my request for care of Tanaka. After checking the documents, I'll return for the procedure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Record the requested address and care of Tanaka, check required documents, and return to complete procedures. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらで確認を進め、ご案内を用意します。今日はご相談として受け付けました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll proceed with the checks and prepare guidance. Today we've received this as a consultation. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お弁当用ののりでしたら、この棚で大きさを比べられます。どのようにお使いですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: For lunchbox nori, compare sizes on this shelf. How will you use it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: おにぎりに巻きます。甘い味が付いていないものがよいのですが、この二つは何が違いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: おにぎりに使う甘くないのりがよく二商品の違いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'll wrap rice balls. I'd like it without sweet seasoning; how do these two differ?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request non-sweet nori for rice balls and ask the difference between two products. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは味付けのりで、原材料欄に砂糖やしょうゆがあります。隣は焼きのりで、表示の原材料はのりだけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is seasoned nori, with sugar and soy sauce in its ingredients. The neighboring roasted nori lists only seaweed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 焼きのりにします。袋の写真では小さく見えますが、一枚を切らずにおにぎり全体へ巻けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 焼きのりを選ぶが写真が小さく見えるので切らずに巻ける大きさか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll choose roasted nori. The bag photo looks small; is one sheet large enough to wrap a whole rice ball without cutting?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose roasted nori but ask whether it is large enough to wrap without cutting despite the small-looking photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 袋には全形と書いてあるので、大きい一枚が入っています。写真は使い方の例で、実際の大きさはこの表示で確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The bag says full-size sheets, so it contains large sheets. The photo is a usage example; this label confirms the actual size.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 大きい一枚なら自分で切れますね。毎日少しずつ使うので、開けた袋をそのまま置いてよいか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 大きい一枚を自分で切ると理解し毎日少し使う開封袋を放置してよいか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: If it's a large sheet, I can cut it myself. I'll use a little daily, so I want to know whether I can leave the opened bag as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Acknowledge you can cut a large sheet, and ask whether an opened bag used a little daily can be left as it is. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 湿気を吸うと食感が変わりやすいので、開封後は口を閉じて乾燥した場所で保管する表示になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Moisture can change the texture, so the label says to close the bag after opening and store in a dry place.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 口を閉じたいですが、この袋は一度切ると閉じられなさそうです。閉じる部分が付いた袋もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 袋を閉じたいが今の商品は閉じにくそうなので閉じる部分付きの商品を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to close it, but this bag doesn't seem resealable once cut. Is there one with a closure?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to close the bag but this one seems difficult, and ask for a product with a closure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 上の段に、開けた後も閉じられる袋の商品があります。原材料と大きさは同じですが、入っている枚数が少なくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The upper shelf has a resealable bag. Ingredients and size are the same, but it contains fewer sheets.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 使い切りやすそうなので、その少ない枚数の袋にします。写真ではなく全形の表示を確認して、使ったら口を閉じます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 少枚数の閉じられる袋を選び全形表示を確かめ使用後に口を閉じると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: That seems easier to finish, so I'll choose the bag with fewer sheets. I'll check the full-size label rather than the photo, and close it after use.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose the resealable bag with fewer sheets, confirm full-size labeling, and close it after use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そちらをお選びですね。お会計へお持ちください。お弁当作りが楽しみになりますね。またお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: That's your choice. Please take it to checkout. Making lunchboxes will be enjoyable. Please come again.
